sloka: आनुकूल्येन धर्मात्मा त्यक्त्वा सुखमनुत्तमम् ।अनुगच्छति काकुत्स्थं भ्रातरं पालयन् वने ।। ५.३८.५९।।।।
transliteration: ānukūlyena dharmātmā tyaktvā sukhamanuttamam ।anugacchati kākutsthaṁ bhrātaraṁ pālayan vane ।। 5.38.59।।।।

translations.english: "Great, righteous Lakshmana had given up his pleasures and followed his brother Rama in his favour into the forest to be able to serve him.
